operators.name: avgpool2d_forward
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: self.avgpool(x) with AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1)
No bias, no activation. Applies 2D average pooling over each channel independently with kernel 3, stride 2, padding 1
Average pooling includes padding but divides by kernel area (3*3=9) regardless of padding (default count_include_pad=True)
Input must be CUDA float32 tensor; output is CUDA float32 tensor of same dtype
Preserves contiguous output layout as produced by reference

operators.name: pow_scalar_forward
semantics: Corresponds to reference statement: torch.pow(x, self.pow) where self.pow is a 0-dim float32 tensor on CUDA
Broadcasting: exponent is scalar, so applies to all elements
Preserves shape, dtype, device, and strides as input
Apply AvgPool2d(kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1) to input x of shape [128,3,1024,1024]
Output shape [128,3,512,512], dtype float32, device CUDA
Implementation must exactly match PyTorch AvgPool2d semantics including padding handling
Element-wise power with scalar exponent self.pow (float32 2.0)
Output same shape [128,3,512,512], dtype float32, device CUDA
Return final tensor after power operation, same as step_002 output
